import random


def generate_test_case():
    # generate length of array from 1 to 5000
    length = random.randint(1, 5000)

    # generate distinct array
    array = random.sample(range(-10000, 10000), length)

    # sort array in ascending order
    array.sort()

    # generate random pivot index from 1 to length
    pivot = random.randint(1, length)

    # rotate array at pivot index
    nums = array[pivot:] + array[:pivot]

    # generate target from -10000 to 10000
    target = random.randint(-10000, 10000)

    return nums, target
